notes.title: Day 1 Update #1 - Fixed Achievement Bugs and Other minor issues
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

This is the Day 1 update of Koverpark Haunted Subway. One of the players reported that there were error messages popping up when trying to load the game which required immediate attention.
I have fixed the issues and pushed a new build which you can download through your Steam client.

List of the bugs fixed:
1. "Golden Key" achievement issues has now been fixed and the player should be able to unlock the said achievement when the item is collected.

2. Variable missing errors were showing up when trying to load a saved level. This issue is now fixed.

There might be a few minor bugs in the game which will be fixed in the following update. Feel free to let me know if you encounter issues while playing the game.

Thank you for your patience and for your continuous support!

Best Regards,
Anamik
